exposure: Type of Cesarean section (emergency vs elective)
Mode of delivery (Cesarean section or vaginal delivery)
cohort: 12,540 women who delivered between 2015 and 2021 at a hospital in Somalia
finding: The study found a slight increase in cesarean delivery rates during the study period, with an overall cesarean section rate of 21.6%, which is higher than the 10-15% recommended by the WHO in developing countries.
mod_finding: The two most common indications for cesarean delivery were previous C-sections (22.3%) and fetal distress (22.1%).
gest_age: Term deliveries were more likely to be Cesarean sections.
